name: CertScore.ai MCP Light
tagline: No-auth public website privacy-risk scans with evidence and limitations
description: Scan or reuse a bounded public website review for observed cookies and trackers, CMP and consent controls, privacy-policy and transparency signals, regulatory review context, and HTTPS/TLS observations. Results include evidence references and explicit coverage limitations for human or agentic review; they are not legal advice, certification, or a compliance determination.

install.notes: No account, API key, OAuth flow, or headers are required. Keep scan creation under user control and retrieve a completed findings bundle before summarizing results.
